title: Isandro and the Oath Again
author: August Hartwell
blurb: Gideon Okafor, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
